summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, announcing the appointment of Mr. Jie Yang (Jack Yang), an existing Executive Director, as Chief Investment Officer effective June 1, 2026. The board also established an Investment Committee under Mr. Yang's oversight to review material capital expenditures and M&A proposals. No changes in compensation or other terms were disclosed. The appointment and committee creation represent an internal management/structural change, not a routine proxy or meeting notice. Watch for future M&A activity under the new committee.
